text:
Maria: @eng-ml intake: Customer Baird Health requested onboarding of baird-7b into Private (VPC). They want int8 quantization, 8k context, target P95 latency <200ms on A100-80GB, throughput ~40 req/s, and QA regression <=1.5% vs our baseline. Attaching sample prompts and a QA eval set: https://example.com/baird-samples

Ajay: Uploaded the samples. Quick Q — is this on-prem or VPC? KMS/HSM required? Also what's the tokenization source (HF or custom)?

Maria: VPC. They require KMS integration + audit logs. Tokenizer is baird-tokenizer-v2 (customer-provided).

Sam: Prioritization check: is this a paid pilot? If yes, move to high. 

Maria: Yes, PO signed for a Private trial and Dedicated reserved capacity. High priority.

Ajay: Proposed triage/bring-up plan (short):
1) Baseline FP16 smoke: ensure model loads, tokenizer alignment, basic generation sanity.
2) Latency baseline: bench FP16 end-to-end (P95 target).
3) Quant experiments: run int8_dynamic and int8_static variants, measure quality delta.
4) Eval harness: run QA, toxicity, and hallucination tests. Compare to baseline. 
5) Fallbacks: if quality loss >1.5% try QAT or bfloat16; prepare canary route.
6) Ops: prepare canary config, KMS key, audit logging, and capacity gating.

Ajay: Quick commands I'm going to run:
```
# smoke load
python tools/serve_check.py --model baird-7b --dtype fp16 --ctx 8192
# perf bench (quant)
python tools/bench.py --model baird-7b --quant int8_dynamic --batch 1 --tokens 512
# eval
python eval/harness.py --suite qa --model baird-7b --quant int8_dynamic --out results.json
```

Lena: Note: we've seen tokenizer mismatch with baird-tokenizer-v2 before — watch for off-by-one BOS tokens and embedding drift. I can run tokenizer diagnostics.

Carter: I'll spin up a dev node (A100-80GB) and run the baseline perf tomorrow morning. 

CI-Bot: eval-harness/baird-7b/int8_dynamic queued — job id 4521.

Maria: Action items & owners: Ajay = quant + eval harness, Carter = perf & dev node, Lena = tokenizer compatibility, Sam = customer comms & rollout plan. Target report in 72h. @everyone please react with :thumbsup: if ok.

Carter: Ack, will post logs to the thread when done.

Ajay: If int8 underperforms, I'll try per-channel quantization and a small calibration set (~1k prompts) before escalating to QAT.

Sam: Noted. Add a canary policy: start at 5% traffic, monitor latency & QA metrics, ramp to 50% after no regressions for 24h.

Maria: Thanks — I'll open an onboarding ticket and link this thread.
